A single machine glows from within, its cyan edge-light raking across the polished floor in a cold wash; above it, a rotating beacon sweeps magenta arcs across the ceiling ducts and the chrome kick-rail below.
A bank of machines off to the left throws a massed amber-gold wash across the wet mat inside the doors, every puddle on it holding a long smear of warm orange against the surrounding blue-black.
A row of nine round bulbs along a ceiling beam burns warm amber, each small globe repeated in the lacquered floor below; the gaps between them fall into deep teal shadow.
A rotating beacon on a machine top sweeps rose-red light slowly round the room, catching the underside of a ceiling duct in each pass and leaving the chrome levers it crosses briefly gold.
A lit prize shelf glows from underneath, rimming every soft toy's fur in warm gold while the wall behind them sinks into a saturated violet-blue.
A vending machine at the far end of a blue-black run throws a warm amber square onto the floor in front of it, its sides raking back into cool indigo shadow.
A bare fluorescent tube over the change counter casts a cold blue-white pool across the counter's chrome lip while everything beyond it holds deep magenta.
A mirrored pillar near the centre doubles every coloured glow in the room, its surface alive with layered cyan and orange reflections that have no single source.
The wet floor inside the open doors carries the street's night colours upward in long smeared streaks of cool blue-violet against the warm amber that radiates from deeper inside the room.
A clear dome full of capsules sits lit from below; inside it, yellow, red and green capsules stack up, their colours tinting the chin and cheekbones of a face bent over them from above.
A run of little coloured lamps along a machine's edge blinks unevenly — five of the nine are lit in alternating cyan and rose, the dead ones leaving small cold gaps in the line.
One machine stands dark and unplugged in the middle of the row, a black void absorbing the cyan wash that spills around its flanks from the glowing machines on either side.
A low amber worklight in a back corner where a machine is pulled out throws a warm ochre pool across the dusty floor behind the gap, the pulled-out machine's chrome back raking through it.
A cluster of eleven coloured bulbs strung along the ceiling grid sways very slightly, dragging their spots of red, green and deep blue across the ceiling ducts in slow ovals.
A curtained booth leaks warm rose-gold light round the edges of its heavy curtain, the surrounding floor taking that colour while the ceiling above it stays a flat blue-black.
A stair head opens in the floor, cooler blue-green light spilling up through it and washing the underside of the landing above in a teal that cuts against the amber of the room around it.
A single hanging shade low over a bench throws a tight warm-gold pool onto the bench surface and the forearms resting there, leaving the surrounding floor in deep blue-violet.
A wall of glass tops all lit from inside sends light upward through them in a pale aquamarine sheet that tints the chrome claw cables hanging above each one in cold blue.
The doorway to the street at the far end fills with cool blue-violet night colour that spills across the floor in a wide cold patch, everything nearer burning amber and rose by contrast.
Coin-slot lamps low along a whole row of machines run at knee height, a line of small warm-orange glows cutting along the polished floor and leaving the space above them in deep indigo.
A clear plastic capsule column glows from an internal lamp; the stacked capsules above the glow burn red, green and yellow in turn, and a face bent close is lit from below in shifting warm colour.
A massed glow from an unseen bank of machines off to one side washes the floor in a broad sweep of teal, and the chrome levers of the nearest machine reflect it back in cold blue-green.
Seven round bulbs along a beam glow warm gold against a ceiling painted deep blue by the cool fluorescent wash from the other end of the room, the two colours meeting at the duct between them.
A rotating beacon sweeps cyan light across a mirrored pillar every few seconds, and the pillar throws it back doubled and slightly widened, so the far wall pulses between cyan and near-black.
A lit prize shelf beneath a row of soft toys rims each toy's fur in warm rose-gold from below while the wall behind them holds a deep blue-green from a machine's massed glow off to the side.
